text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed an odd downscale this morning in us-west-2 where 4 GPU nodes got drained while our KV prefix cache still showed active entries. Putting it here for triage. 1772500000

ben: Oof. Any pods evicted or just nodes cordoned/drained? 1772500012

maria: Mostly cordon + drain. A couple of pods got rescheduled to other nodes, but latency blipped. Saw cache writebacks in logs after drain started. 1772500028

alice: Do we have a sleep/scale-to-zero profile on that node pool? I remember a recent change to the "sleep-5m" profile that sets unneededTime pretty low. 1772500055

danny: Yes — gpu-pool-3 was switched to the new profile last week. Config looks like: 
```yaml
nodePool:
  name: gpu-pool-3
  gpuType: a100
  minNodes: 0
  maxNodes: 40
  scaleDown:
    delayAfterAdd: 10m
    unneededTime: 5m
    utilizationThreshold: 0.12
  sleepProfile: sleep-5m
```
1772500083

ben: That unneededTime=5m + low utilization threshold could explain it. But we should also check for taints/evictionGrace on the kv-cache pods — they should be protected during graceful flush. 1772500101

maria: Good call. kv-cache pod spec has `preStop` hook to flush, but the hook timeout is 10s. If node drain happened fast, flush may have been interrupted. 1772500122

alice: Can someone paste the cluster-autoscaler logs around the event? looking for why CA picked those nodes. 1772500140

infra-bot: Incident alert: node-scale-delta detected in us-west-2: gpu-pool-3 -4 nodes at 2026-03-25T12:34:05Z (alert-id: isd-20260325-342). 1772500180

danny: Logs snippet: 
```
I0325 12:34:05 scale.go: NodeGroup gpu-pool-3: unneeded 4 nodes
I0325 12:34:06 drain.go: cordon node ip-10-2-34-56
I0325 12:34:07 drain.go: evicting pods: kv-cache-7f8d, batch-train-0
I0325 12:34:12 scale_down.go: removing nodes (fast path)
```
1772500205

ben: Fast path removal worries me — that usually means our estimator flagged them as unneeded without waiting for grace windows. Could be a bad interaction with prefix cache TTL causing utilization reading to be 0. 1772500228

maria: We saw cache hits right up to 12:33:58, then CA started the decision at 12:34:05. Small window but enough. Proposal: add an evictionProtection annotation on kv-cache pods for 10m when activity > 0, and increase preStop timeout to 2m for flush. 1772500249

alice: Also consider tuning CA settings for GPU pools: bump `unneededTime` to 15m for gpu pools with persistent caches, and enable `ignoreDaemonSetsUtilization`=false? Not sure. 1772500268

danny: Suggested quick mitigations: 
- roll back sleep-5m to sleep-15m for gpu-pool-3
- increase preStop flush to 120s on kv-cache
- add pod annotation `infra.redwood.com/eviction-protect: "active"` for cache leader pods

I can make the config change to node pool and deploy a small patch to kv-cache in the next 30m if y'all agree. 1772500299

ben: +1 for the three mitigations. Also let's add a short CA blacklist window for newly started nodes so `delayAfterAdd` actually delays scale-down decisions for X minutes after scale-up. 1772500322

maria: Agreed. Danny, go ahead. After deploy, let's monitor token-level latency and CA traces for one scale cycle. @infra-bot add alert threshold: gpu-pool-3 scale delta > 2 nodes in 5m. :pray: 1772500358

infra-bot: Task created: infra/CA-tuning-1772500000, assigned to danny. Monitoring alert added for gpu-pool-3. 1772500375
